tEn: DeepSeek's Consistent 'No' to Being the Next BAT: A 4-Hour Investor Meeting
tZh: 梁文锋 4 小时投资人会议实录：持续说不，DeepSeek 不做下一个 BAT
sEn: Liang Wenfeng reiterates that DeepSeek will not follow the BAT model, focusing on a unique path.
sZh: 梁文锋在4小时投资人会议上持续强调，DeepSeek不会成为下一个BAT。
absEn: Recording: May 20 · Organized: July 16, 2026_Audio duration about 3 hours 44 minutes_
absZh: 录音：5月20日 · 整理：2026年7月16日_音频时长约 3 小时 44 分 钟_

contrib.en: Rejects profit maximization; open-sources models and sets API pricing at 10-month cost recovery to maintain low prices.
contrib.zh: 反对利润最大化；开源模型并将API定价设为10个月回本以确保低价。

contrib.en: Identifies team stability as the only core interest; attracts talent via AGI vision rather than monetary incentives.
contrib.zh: 将团队稳定视为唯一核心利益；通过AGI愿景而非金钱激励吸引人才。

contrib.en: Proposes a clear AGI roadmap: chain-of-thought → agent → continual learning → self-iterating singularity → embodied intelligence.
contrib.zh: 提出清晰的AGI路线图：思维链→智能体→持续学习→自我迭代奇点→具身智能。

contrib.en: Claims that open source does not harm business when profit margin is modest; even the strongest models will be open-sourced.
contrib.zh: 主张在适度利润下开源不影响商业，甚至最强模型也会开源。

contrib.en: Develops TileLang compiler to decouple from NVIDIA CUDA ecosystem, enabling domestic GPU adaptation with only hardware gap.
contrib.zh: 开发TileLang编译器以脱离NVIDIA CUDA生态，使国产GPU适配仅存硬件差距。

contrib.en: Focuses on core intelligence research (pre-training, post-training) over peripheral tasks like video generation and world models.
contrib.zh: 专注于核心智能研究（预训练、后训练），而非视频生成、世界模型等外围任务。

limits.en: Compute resource shortage: only ~20k H-equivalent GPUs, unable to train 800B-parameter models like frontier US labs.
limits.zh: 算力资源短缺：仅约2万张H级GPU，无法像美国前沿实验室那样训练800B参数模型。

limits.en: Domestic chips (Huawei) have 2-year lag and 4:1 efficiency ratio vs. NVIDIA; production capacity insufficient for scale.
limits.zh: 国产芯片（华为）相比NVIDIA落后2年且效率为4:1；产能不足。

limits.en: Consensus-driven decision-making may slow down pivots and fail to resolve internal disagreements.
limits.zh: 共识驱动决策可能拖慢转向，且无法解决内部分歧。

limits.en: Vision of AGI may be overly optimistic; the claim that world models are irrelevant to intelligence upper bound is debatable.
limits.zh: AGI愿景可能过于乐观；认为世界模型与智能上限无关的说法存疑。

limits.en: Reliance on NVIDIA hardware purchase and geopolitical risks could disrupt supply chain.
limits.zh: 依赖NVIDIA硬件采购及地缘政治风险可能中断供应链。
